name: table-tennis-live
description: Shared, realtime table tennis tournament sheet. Login as admin with a token or spectate read-only; play-in qualifiers instead of free byes; the winner lands exactly on the configurable points-to-win (7-0 wins instantly); round robin is never match-capped; the flow map renders every stage including the knockout after pools; tournaments auto-save and resume. Season archive, star players.
